_usage: Read this JSON as generation instructions for Nano Banana 2. Attach Table1.png as the reference image. Follow reference_image and constants strictly; randomize freely from pools each run.
task: Generate a hyper-realistic Dutch Golden Age pronkstilleven (sumptuous banquet still life, c.1650), reinvented — never a copy of any historical work.
format: 16:9 landscape, photographic detail, indistinguishable from a real photograph, true-to-life textures, materials and light physics.

reference_image.role: FIXED BASE — the permanent stage of the scene
reference_image.content: A real dark wooden table: warm reddish-brown aged wood top, visible thick front edge, carved apron below, surrounded by pure black.
rules: Keep this EXACT table every generation: same wood grain, same reddish-brown color, same front edge, same carved apron, same height in frame, same low straight-on viewpoint.
Do NOT recolor, restyle, move, tilt, rescale, crop or redraw the table.
Do NOT cut, cover or hide the front edge and apron — the wooden edge stays fully visible along the bottom.
Objects rest ON the top surface, may lean or hang slightly over, but never erase the edge.
Build the whole scene ON this tabletop only. Everything above the table is the same pure black void.

constants.perspective: Identical every time — the low, straight-on viewpoint of the reference. No change of angle, tilt or scale.
constants.tileable: Table runs full width and continues beyond both side edges, so multiple outputs line up side by side into one continuous table. Objects may be cut by the left/right frame edges, continuing off-frame.
constants.darkness: ALMOST PURE BLACKNESS — overwhelmingly black, extremely underexposed, the darkest possible still life. Over 90% of the frame is deep black void. Nearly everything on the table swallowed by shadow, barely readable; only faint hints of form survive.
constants.lighting: NON-DIRECTIONAL — no single light source, no beam, no direction, no cast shadows revealing direction. A few tiny points emerge feebly from the black on their own: a dim self-glow, a single weak wet highlight on a rim, one barely-lit edge floating in the void. Rare, isolated, minuscule glints drowned in darkness, coming from nowhere. Deep tenebrism.

variation_rule: CRITICAL: every generation must look completely different. Do NOT default to the lobster/lemon/grapes cliché. Each run pick a DIFFERENT random subset from EVERY pool, respecting its pick count, and deliberately leave many whole categories out. Never repeat the same combination across runs. Rotate which categories appear. The ONLY constants are the table, the perspective and the darkness.
abundance: MAXIMALIST — the tabletop crammed end to end, piled high and overflowing, but almost entirely hidden in shadow, only faint fragments perceptible.

textiles.note: dark tones, heaped/twisted/knotted, partly draped over the top but never fully hiding the front edge

naturalia_shells.note: wunderkammer naturalia collected among the objects

dead_game_creatures.note: vary species widely, never the same set
items: a hunting dog nosing the edge

fruit_veg_food.note: many bruised, moldy, blackened, split, over-ripe, liquefying, crawling with insects

items: a single fresh bloom among the decay

insects_vermin.note: small, crawling on the food and objects, reinforcing decay

mood: Photorealistic, extreme detail, decadent vanitas of excess and decay.
